neighbours.label: A noun naming the role a product plays as an add-on to something else (seasoning, additive, accessory, garnish, supplement, jewelry)
fire: A pinch of smoked paprika makes a lovely seasoning for roasted potatoes.
This silk belt is an elegant accessory for any evening dress.
Crushed eggshells work well as a garden additive for tomatoes.
Fresh parsley is a simple garnish for grilled fish.
She sells handmade jewelry at the weekend market.
Many runners take a magnesium supplement after long races.
Toasted sesame oil adds a nutty seasoning to stir-fries.
A chunky bracelet is the perfect accessory for a plain shirt.
quiet: A pinch of smoked paprika fell on the kitchen floor.
This silk dress was made by a tailor in Milan.
Crushed eggshells were swept from the garden path.
Fresh parsley grows quickly in a sunny window.
She sells used books at the weekend market.
Many runners take a long nap after long races.
Toasted bread with butter is her favorite breakfast.
A plain shirt was hanging behind the door.
